str_a_curve_of_the_chance_of_being_help: A curve of the chance of being right against the confidence, fitted to every review, as Wood and Kahl recommend.
str_a_threshold_applies_to_new_help: A threshold applies to new detections only; the older ones stay in the database.
str_a_validation_marker_you_have_help: A validation marker: you have checked that the species occurs here
str_accepted_even_when_its_help: Accepted even when its probability of occurrence at the location is below the minimum now
str_already_at_the_threshold_the_help: Already at the threshold: the one in force is the suggested value.
str_back_to_the_factory_defaults_help: Back to the factory defaults: palette, contrast, floor and range
str_choosing_a_list_makes_it_the_help: Choosing a list makes it the active one
str_choosing_a_saved_list_copies_it_help: Choosing a saved list copies it over the current one (asks first)
str_confidence_set_by_hand_for_the_help: Confidence set by hand for the species (species page or Calibrate thresholds); - = none, the station's applies
str_covered_the_share_of_the_help: Covered = the share of the detections above the threshold that are in bands with reviews; a suggestion needs at least 80%.
str_delete_the_saved_list_q: Delete the saved list {name}? It leaves the picklist.
str_discard_changes_and_load: The table has changes not saved. Discard them and load {name}?
str_draw_the_spectrogram_without_help: Draw the sonogram without sending the audio to the speakers
str_each_confidence_band_counts_help: Each confidence band counts with the number of detections it really has, not with the number you reviewed.
str_each_line_is_a_confidence_band: Each line is a confidence band.
str_each_line_keeps_only_the_help: Each line keeps only the detections at or above that value.
str_every_detection_of_this_species_help: Every detection of this species has an answer.
str_every_species_the_station_can_help: Every species the station can detect: the model's species, limited to the Allowed species list when it has species, without the Never accept species; the minimum probability of occurrence at the location is ignored
str_exclude_species_from_the_help: Exclude species from the analysis by adding them to the Never accept table.
str_false_human_noise_ignore_or_help: False = Human, Noise, Ignore or changed to another species.
str_filter_species_common_help: Filter species… (common, scientific or English name)
str_gamma_of_the_colour_ramp_below_help: Gamma of the colour ramp: below 1 lifts faint sounds, above 1 keeps only the strong ones
str_groups_birds_mammals_amphibians_help: Groups (birds, mammals, amphibians, insects, domestic) and regions come from a formal reference: GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility).
str_guaranteed_below_the_target_help: Guaranteed below the target: review more to confirm.
str_guaranteed_the_lower_end_of_the_help: Guaranteed = the lower end of the 95% interval of that precision.
str_guaranteed_the_worst_likely_help: Guaranteed = the worst likely precision with the reviews you have; it rises as you review more.
str_how_the_threshold_is_computed_help: How the threshold is computed, and why
str_in_settings_model_choose_a_help: In {menu:Model}, choose a Shadow model (for example the V2.4 beside the V3) and tick Shadow mode.
str_in_the_exclude_list_the_model_help: In the exclude list: the model records no new detections, so these are older ones: from before the species was excluded, imported (a BirdSuite backup or BirdNET-Pi folder) or moved from another location or station. Delete all to remove them, or keep them as history
str_is_now_the_active_species_list: {name} is now the active species list.
str_it_needs_fewer_reviews_and_does_help: It needs fewer reviews and does not depend on which bands you reviewed more.
str_its_detections_go_to_their_own_help: Its detections go to their own database only (no clips, no notifications).
str_its_value_is_the_confidence_at_help: Its value is the confidence at which a single detection reaches the target, so it is stricter than the precision, which averages every detection above the threshold.
str_keep_this_list_empty_unless_you_help: Keep this list EMPTY unless you are ONLY interested in detecting specific species.
str_list_exists_replace: A list {name} already exists. Replace it with the table?
str_loaded_species_it_applies_from_help: {name} loaded ({n} species): it applies from the next recording.
str_logistic_for_this_species_the_help: Logistic: for this species the confidence does not tell right from false.
str_logistic_needs_at_least_reviews_help: Logistic: needs at least {n} reviews with both answers.
str_logistic_no_confidence_reaches_help: Logistic: no confidence reaches the target.
str_logistic_wood_and_kahl_at_a_help: Logistic (Wood and Kahl): at {v} a detection is right with a {p} chance.
str_lower_the_target_is_already_help: Lower: the target is already reached from {v}, which keeps about {n} more real detections.
str_mean_confidence_of_the_official_help: Mean confidence of the official model
str_mean_confidence_of_the_shadow_model: Mean confidence of the shadow model
str_minimum_confidence_empty_help: Minimum confidence for this species; empty = the global minimum confidence ({pct}%).
str_minimum_confidence_manual_help: Minimum confidence for this species (manual confidence of the species); empty = the global minimum confidence ({value})
str_minimum_probability_for_help: Minimum probability of occurrence for this species, in force when higher than the station minimum: while the week's probability is below it, its detections are left out, also for a whitelisted species.
str_minimum_probability_of_help: Minimum probability of occurrence of the species:
str_moments_same_3_s_window_both_help: Moments (same 3 s window) both models gave this species
str_name_of_the_list: Name of the list (letters, digits, - and _)
str_names_in_parentheses_help: A name in parentheses has no match in the language shown: the model has no such name for the species, so the name it has is shown (the English one, or the line of the list file when the model does not know the species).
str_new_suggestions_species_already_help: {a} new suggestions, {b} species already at the threshold, {c} species whose reviews do not reach the criteria yet.
str_no_detections_of_at_this_station: No detections of {name} at this station.
str_no_detections_of_either_model_help: No detections of either model in this period.
str_no_probability_of_occurrence_help: No probability of occurrence for this species at the location: no threshold of probability of occurrence can be set.
str_no_reviewed_detection_with_yes_help: No reviewed detection with Yes or a cause yet.
str_no_species_reaches_the_criteria_help: No species reaches the criteria yet: review more detections on the species pages.
str_no_threshold_reaches_the_target_help: No threshold reaches the target yet: review the highlighted band in Where to review.
str_now_each_band_is_weighted_by_help: Now each band is weighted by its detections, and the logistic curve is shown beside it.
str_open_the_compression_help: Open the Sonogram page with this Compression setting
str_open_the_silent_setting_help: Open the Sonogram page with this Silent setting
str_opens_on_count_most_first_a_help: Opens on Count, most first; a click on the button already on reverses it
str_pct_of_every_detection_of_the_help: {pct}% of every detection of the two
str_precision_right_divided_by_help: Precision = right divided by right plus false, each band weighted by its number of detections.
str_precision_with_at_least_reviews_help: precision, with at least {n} reviews above the threshold
str_probability_of_occurrence_at_help: Probability of occurrence at the location
str_purge_the_audio_of_these_detections: Purge the audio of these detections?
str_raise_at_the_threshold_in_force_help: Raise: at the threshold in force the precision is {p}, below the target.
str_real_lost_estimate_of_the_real_help: Real lost = estimate of the real detections the threshold would leave out.
str_review_the_highlighted_band_help: Review the highlighted band first: there your answers are the most uncertain and detections are waiting.
str_saved_as_species_an_identical_help: Saved as {name} ({n} species): an identical copy of the active list, Load this list makes it the active one (then edit it).
str_share_of_this_species_moments_help: Share of this species' moments that both models found
str_show_only_one_group_of_species_help: Show only one group of species in both lists
str_signal_at_or_below_this_level_help: Signal at or below this level takes the darkest colour
str_since_the_reviews_follow_the_help: Since the reviews follow the bands you choose and not the detections, the suggestion could come out too high or too low.
str_suggested_the_lowest_confidence_help: Suggested = the lowest confidence whose precision reaches the target, with at least {n} reviews above it and 80% of its detections covered by reviews.
str_suggests_the_threshold_of_every_help: Suggests the threshold of every species whose reviews already reach the criteria of Precision
str_that_is_why_each_species_gets_help: That is why each species gets its own threshold, set from a sample of its detections checked by ear.
str_the_active_list_cannot_be_deleted: {name} is the active list: choose another list first.
str_the_birdnet_confidence_is_not_a_help: The BirdNET confidence is not a probability, and the same value means different things for different species.
str_the_clips_and_spectrograms_are_help: The clips and sonograms are deleted for good and cannot be restored.
str_the_comparison_needs_a_second_help: The comparison needs a second model analysing the same recordings.
str_the_current_list_is_empty_help: The current list is empty: nothing to save
str_the_detections_stay_in_the_help: The detections stay in the database and keep counting in every statistic.
str_the_gbif_backbone_taxonomy_help: The GBIF Backbone Taxonomy gives the class of each label, and GBIF occurrence records give the continents (at least 3 % of the records).
str_the_latest_records_are_shown_help: The latest {n} records are shown: narrow the period or pick Both / Only to see the others.
str_the_location_profile_is_not_help: The location profile is not computed yet (it is built with the first notification of the day).
str_the_most_critical_band_review_help: The most critical band: review it first
str_the_new_suggestions_come_ticked_help: The new suggestions come ticked; a value changed by hand ticks its species.
str_the_precision_used_to_add_up_help: The precision used to add up the reviews as they were, so the bands reviewed most weighed more than they should.
str_the_selected_species_will_be_help: The selected species will be detected even if below the minimum probability of occurrence at the location defined in the settings.
str_the_species_whose_reviews_help: The species whose reviews already reach the criteria of Precision on the species page: first the new suggestions, then those already at the threshold.
str_the_threshold_in_force_already_help: The threshold in force ({now}) already reaches the target.
str_this_is_not_a_recommended_way_help: This is not a recommended way of working, as it bypasses seasonality.
str_this_page_then_compares_the_two_help: This page then compares the two models species by species and record by record.
str_this_section_shows_from_which_help: This section shows from which confidence the detections of this species are real, from your reviews.
str_ticked_in_its_past_detections_help: Ticked = in the exclude list: no longer detected (its past detections stay listed here)
str_to_constrain_the_analyses_to_a_help: To constrain the analyses to a specific set, add them to the Allowed species table.
str_type_to_filter_persists_across_help: Type to filter; persists across reloads
str_use_the_review_button_on_a_help: Use the Review button on a detection to review it.
str_what_the_other_model_gave_at_help: What the other model gave at this same moment
str_where_the_species_lives_gbif_help: Where the species lives (GBIF records: continents with at least 3 % of them); Global species match every region; species without data only with Any region
str_where_to_review_highlights_the_help: Where to review highlights the band whose precision is the most uncertain (the widest 95% Wilson interval) among those with detections waiting.
str_width_of_the_colour_scale_above_help: Width of the colour scale above the floor
